subject: mathematics
title: Chance Check
objective: Describe real-life outcomes as certain, likely, unlikely, or impossible.
introduction: Milo has a new mission! 🐱✨ A certain event will happen, an impossible event cannot happen in the situation, and likely or unlikely describe different chances. Ready to explore?
